notes: «يرفعه إلى» is a gap: the transmitter between الهمداني and داود is not named, so it stays unnamed in its place
«أبي جعفر أو أبي عبد الله» is one level of two alternatives; the Imam is written inside the chain after «عن», so kind narrator
«- رحمه الله -» is a blessing and «3-80» the report number: both left out
